answer: Require every agent to lock a small stake and emit a verifiable liveness pulse every epoch; a missed or forged pulse burns part of the stake. New identities start with zero reputation and can only earn trust by acting as a bridge, relaying and countersigning real work for established agents, so a sybil farm cannot mint reputation from nothing. The nectar is the reward: only attested, stake-backed agents share emission, so creating a thousand fake identities costs a thousand stakes and yields nothing without real work.
